title: Mass fraction freezing
description: Essential: Correctly computes the mass fraction η = A'/A = 4.0/5.0 = 0.80.

title: Heat transfer relation
description: Important: Applies energy balance linking area under T-h curve to latent heat (Q = -κA/v = mL).

title: Droplet temperature differential equation
description: Important: Sets up correct convection equation: mc_water v (dT_d/dx) = κ(T - T_d) for the linear profile.

title: Characteristic distance use
description: Important: Identifies and uses the characteristic distance x_0 = (c_water * A) / L or equivalent to solve the ODE.

title: Final temperature calculation
description: Essential: Arrives at a final droplet temperature near 8°C, accounting for the small ΔT from the linear profile.

title: Viscous heating correction
description: Optional: Includes the temperature correction ΔT* = gA/L due to viscous dissipation.

title: Constant melting temperature
description: Important: Recognizes droplet temperature remains at 0°C during phase change in the inversion layer.

title: Sign error in heat transfer
description: Pitfall: Misinterprets sign of heat transfer (dQ = -κ(T - T_d) dh/v) leading to incorrect energy balance.

title: Confusing areas A and A'
description: Pitfall: Swaps or misapplies the given areas A (melting) and A' (freezing) in the fraction calculation.
